text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu, the new flavor looks delicious.
Thanks for the food—)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Oh no, it's spilling—
Ah, it stained my skirt...!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I need to wash this quickly...!
Where can I wash it... um, let's see—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gotten her favorite skirt dirty,
North Flight was feeling downcast...
